name: AK16C - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), AQI Display
highlights: One Index Number Anyone Can Act On — The AQI bar collapses eight readings into a single 0–500 figure with a colour scale. A hotel guest or a classroom assistant knows what to do without knowing what TVOC stands for.
The Detail Stays Available — All eight underlying values remain on screen. The index is a layer on top, not a replacement — so a facilities manager and a guest can read the same device.
Laser Particulate Split — PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 measured separately, feeding the index rather than being averaged away.
2000 mAh, Six Hours — USB-C, roughly three hours to full, 249 g.
One Layer Up, Same Platform — AK16C adds the index to the AK16A body without changing the enclosure, packaging or 30-per-carton spec — two tiers for the same buyer from one production line.
